band: band11 -- r=4 Reeve-dimension census, hunter 11/12: UNBOUNDED WEIGHT, TARGETED (maximise V/c over all shapes)
sessions: two sessions on 2026-07-21; session 2 (this file) added the targeted V/(c+h3) climbs at K=64/200/600, a fresh hive4.py --selftest, 120 new scanner-vs-hive4 cross-checks at gaps <= 64, three new LR-engine anchors, and an exact re-derivation of 6a1 = 3(c+h3) - V on every record. Session 2 ALSO attempted two larger exhaustive regions -- the L1-ball sum(g) <= 64 and the cube [0,16]^9 -- and ABORTED BOTH as infeasible under the load of the 12 concurrent hunters (timing fit on this machine: L1-ball wall time grows ~3.7x per +6 in S; S=36 took 94 s, S=42 took 346 s, so S=64 projects to ~11 h and cube [0,16]^9 to several hours). Nothing from the aborted runs is reported; the exhaustive regions below are exactly the ones that ran to completion.
target: counterexample to the King-Tollu-Toumazet (2004) positivity conjecture: a triple (lam,mu,nu), |lam|+|mu|=|nu|, whose stretched LR polynomial P(n)=c(n nu; n lam, n mu) has a strictly negative coefficient
cell: r = 4  (hive polytope Q lives in R^3 = the Reeve dimension; deg P = dim Q <= 3)

result_headline.min_a1_attained_at: every unimodular hive simplex (h* = (1,0,0,0), V = 1, c = 4, P = C(n+3,3)); occurs at arbitrarily large weight, e.g. lam=(579,283,69), mu=(519,299,26), nu=(584,515,420,256), |nu| = 1775, and lam=(207,58,40), mu=(400,287,165), nu=(440,288,234,195) found by the K=200 climb
result_headline.interpretation: V/c is NOT a discriminant: it rises monotonically to 6 along every ray in gap space while a1 grows linearly and stays positive. The scale-free discriminants are (i) the ratio V/(c+h3), which must exceed 3 and never did -- the closest approach over everything scanned is 2.9999317, and the exact deficit 3(c+h3) - V = 6a1 = 4459 is a POSITIVE integer there, not a rounding artifact -- and (ii) max V at c = 4 (empty lattice 3-polytope = the Reeve mechanism), which must reach 13 and was equal to 1 in EVERY region scanned, so every empty r=4 hive 3-polytope seen was unimodular and no Reeve simplex T(p,q) with q >= 2 ever occurred.

moduli_reduction.claim: Q(lam,mu,nu) for r=4 depends on (lam,mu,nu) only through the 9 gaps a=(l1-l2,l2-l3,l3-l4), b=(m1-m2,m2-m3,m3-m4), c=(n1-n2,n2-n3,n3-n4), up to an INTEGER translation of R^3; hence L(n)=#(nQ cap Z^3), V, h*, P are functions of the gap vector alone. A gap vector is realisable by partitions iff D = Cw-Aw-Bw == 0 (mod 4), Aw = 3a3+2a2+a1 etc.
moduli_reduction.consequence: a gap-space census is a census at UNBOUNDED WEIGHT: one gap vector = infinitely many triples (lam,mu,nu) of arbitrarily large |nu|, all with the same P. The census is therefore exhaustive over ALL r=4 triples of EVERY weight whose consecutive-part gaps lie in the stated region.

exact_identities_used.a1: 6 a1 = 11 + 2 h1 - h2 + 2 h3 = 3*c + 3*h3 - V   (h3 = # interior lattice points)
exact_identities_used.a1_identity_recheck_session2: 3*(c+h3) - V recomputed by hand in exact integer arithmetic on all four extremal records (climb K=64/200/600 and random K=300) and equals the scanner's 6a1 in all four cases
exact_identities_used.negativity_criterion: a1 < 0  <==>  V > 3*(c + h3). Hence V/c > 3 is NECESSARY, and when c = 4 (h*_1 = 0, an empty lattice 3-polytope such as a Reeve simplex T(p,q), V = q) it is exactly V >= 13
exact_identities_used.scaling: for integer t, Q(t*g) = t*Q(g), so a1(t*g) = t*a1(g) and V(t*g) = t^3 V(g): the SIGN of a1 is constant along each integer ray in gap space. Verified independently with hive4.py on 40 dim-3 directions at t = 2,3 (80/80 exact). Consequently V/c -> 6 and V/(c+h3) -> 3 from below along every ray, so both maxima are attained at the largest polytope of whatever region is scanned -- they are scale artifacts and are reported as such.

honesty: Absence of a counterexample proves nothing whatsoever about the King-Tollu-Toumazet conjecture and is never evidence for it. The exhaustive regions above are closed windows, nothing more; outside them the r=4 cell remains open. The two larger exhaustive regions attempted in session 2 were abandoned for wall-clock reasons and contribute nothing. No anomaly was tuned away: the one ANCHOR: FAIL produced this session is an engine-B state-budget cap and is reported as a FAIL verdict with its cause.
